assertions.subject: hypovolemia
assertions.quote: Vital sign abnormalities, such as hypotension, may indicate hypovolemia

assertions.subject: anemia
assertions.quote: labs to evaluate hemoglobin and hematocrit in patients where hypovolemia or anemia is suspected

assertions.subject: pulmonary embolism
assertions.quote: Hypoxia can indicate a pulmonary embolism

assertions.subject: aortic stenosis
assertions.quote: Physical exam findings of a new murmur can indicate dangerous valvular pathologies, such as aortic stenosis

assertions.subject: mitral regurgitation
assertions.quote: Physical exam findings of a new murmur can indicate dangerous valvular pathologies, such as aortic stenosis or mitral regurgitation

assertions.subject: Seizure disorder
assertions.quote: All patients should receive a screening electrocardiogram (ECG)

assertions.subject: cardiac conditions
assertions.quote: ECG features, such as a new left bundle branch block, Brugada pattern, arrhythmogenic RV dysplasia, prolonged QTc, or hypertrophic cardiomyopathy patterns, suggest high risk

assertions.subject: cardiac conditions
assertions.quote: sinus bradycardia, dysrhythmias, and second or third-degree AV blocks should all warrant further workup
